name: Notion
description: Connect your Notion workspace to read, create, and manage pages and databases
description_zh: 连接你的 Notion 工作区，读取、创建和管理页面与数据库

mcp_config.name: notion
mcp_config.description: Notion workspace integration - read, search, create pages and databases

auth.help_text: Create an internal integration at notion.so/my-integrations and copy the token
auth.help_text_zh: 在 notion.so/my-integrations 创建内部集成并复制令牌

name: Todoist
description: Manage tasks, projects, and reminders in Todoist
description_zh: 管理 Todoist 中的任务、项目和提醒

mcp_config.name: todoist
mcp_config.description: Todoist task management - create, update, complete tasks and projects

auth.help_text: Go to Todoist Settings → Integrations → Developer and copy your API token
auth.help_text_zh: 前往 Todoist 设置 → 集成 → 开发者，复制 API 令牌

name: Linear
description: Manage issues, projects, and cycles in Linear
description_zh: 管理 Linear 中的问题、项目和迭代周期

mcp_config.name: linear
mcp_config.description: Linear project management - issues, projects, cycles, teams

auth.help_text: Go to Linear Settings → API and create a personal API key
auth.help_text_zh: 前往 Linear 设置 → API，创建个人 API 密钥

name: Tencent Docs
description: Create and manage documents, spreadsheets, slides, and mind maps in Tencent Docs
description_zh: 在腾讯文档中创建和管理文档、表格、幻灯片和思维导图

mcp_config.name: tencent-docs
mcp_config.description: Tencent Docs - smart docs, excel, slides, mind maps, flowcharts

auth.help_text: Open your Tencent Docs space, click ≡ → Use MCP → Get MCP Token, then copy the token
auth.help_text_zh: 打开腾讯文档空间，点击右上角 ≡ → 使用 MCP → 获取 MCP Token，复制令牌

name: WPS Docs
description: Query and manage WPS spreadsheet data via Webhook integration
description_zh: 通过 Webhook 集成查询和管理 WPS 表格数据

mcp_config.name: wps
mcp_config.description: WPS Docs - query spreadsheet data via AirScript Webhook

auth.help_text: Create an AirScript webhook in your WPS spreadsheet and copy the URL and Token
auth.help_text_zh: 在 WPS 表格中创建 AirScript Webhook，复制 URL 和 Token

name: HubSpot
description: Search and manage HubSpot CRM contacts, companies, deals, and tickets
description_zh: 搜索并管理 HubSpot CRM 联系人、公司、交易和工单

mcp_config.name: hubspot
mcp_config.description: HubSpot CRM MCP — contacts, companies, deals, tickets

auth.help_text: Create a HubSpot private app and copy the access token into PRIVATE_APP_ACCESS_TOKEN
auth.help_text_zh: 在 HubSpot 创建 Private App，将 Access Token 配置为 PRIVATE_APP_ACCESS_TOKEN

name: Salesforce
description: Query and manage Salesforce org data via the official Salesforce DX MCP server
description_zh: 通过官方 Salesforce DX MCP 服务查询和管理 Salesforce 组织数据

mcp_config.name: salesforce
mcp_config.description: Salesforce DX MCP — orgs, metadata, data, users

auth.help_text: Authorize a local org with Salesforce CLI (sf org login), then keep DEFAULT_TARGET_ORG as the default target org alias
auth.help_text_zh: 使用 Salesforce CLI (sf org login) 授权本地组织，并保持 DEFAULT_TARGET_ORG 为默认目标组织别名

name: Microsoft To Do
description: Manage your Microsoft To Do lists, tasks, and checklist items via your Microsoft account
description_zh: 通过你的 Microsoft 账户管理 Microsoft To Do 清单、任务和子任务

mcp_config.name: microsoft-todo
mcp_config.description: Microsoft To Do - lists, tasks, checklist items via Microsoft Graph
mcp_config.post_connect_guide: Microsoft To Do has been added. In the chat, tell the assistant: "Sign me in to Microsoft To Do", then open the returned link and enter the code in your browser to finish authorization.
mcp_config.post_connect_guide_zh: Microsoft To Do 已添加。请在对话中告诉助手：「帮我登录 Microsoft To Do」，然后打开返回的链接，在浏览器中输入授权码完成登录。

auth.help_text: Sign in with your Microsoft account through the assistant. No API key or app registration needed.
auth.help_text_zh: 通过助手使用你的 Microsoft 账户登录，无需 API 密钥或应用注册。
